content: अवचन {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] Not speaking, silent, speechless; शकुन्तला साध्वसादवचना तिष्ठति <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. .{@-नम्@} [अभावे, <sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Absence of assertion, silence, taciturnity; अवचनेऽग्निष्टोम; <ls>Kāty.</ls> .²2 Censure, blame, reproof; ˚कर {%a.%} not doing what one is bid, disobedient.
